## Rules

- Tests consume the P7.1 seam as written and do not patch the
container between repository operations. Missing TTL resolves to 3600; explicit null stays null;
zero stays zero; a positive integer is preserved. The same repository object observes the current
default in central, tenant and restored-central contexts; an explicit override stays fixed. If a
witness is red, return it to P7.1 rather than changing product code here.

## Guidance

Use a recording Laravel database manager/resolver fixture with three successive
defaults and assert the connection selected for each actual repository operation. Keep the TTL
matrix table-driven and include invalid-value accumulation already promised by P7.1.
